content.text: {"judgements":[{"id":"row0-ilo0-contentilo","label":"NOT_ALIGNED","explanation":"The source (Week 1 content) is a course orientation: course contents, requirements and activities, objectives, grading system and policies on absences, tardiness and examinations. The target ILO asks students to demonstrate Augustinian, Marian and missionary Christ-centered Spirituality through value webbing. (1) The ILO is not about this week's content: nothing in the orientation teaches or introduces spirituality or value webbing. (2) The verb 'Demonstrate' is observable, but the performance (value webbing) is not specified and nothing in the content prepares it. (3) A Demonstrating-level performance on spirituality is far above what an orientation week can teach. (4) The ILO brings in a skill, value webbing, that the content never teaches. It belongs to a later value-integration lesson or to the course CLO, not to the orientation. The ILO should be about the orientation content, such as the course objectives and requirements.","sourceQuote":"C.
